Description: One-click HealthOmics per-workflow run-metrics dashboard (1-6 workflow ids; 6-plot row each; pure CloudFormation).

Fn::Join: {"type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2, "properties": {"markdown": "# HealthOmics Workflow Usage\n**One row per workflow, 6 plots each** (avg + p99 across tasks/runs): CPU utilization %, memory utilization %, filesystem I/O (read/write), network I/O (receive/transmit), run shared-filesystem usage, scratch storage usage.\nCPU/memory are per-task usage/limit, aggregated with avg / p99. Run filesystem usage is DYNAMIC-lagged (>30 min) and only non-zero for workflows that use the shared filesystem. Scratch storage usage is per-task local scratch (DYNAMIC/SHARED mode lags up to 20 min)."}}
